import unreal
actors=unreal.EditorLevelLibrary.get_all_level_actors()
comp=None
for actor in actors:
    for candidate in actor.get_components_by_class(unreal.NiagaraComponent):
        asset=candidate.get_asset()
        if asset and asset.get_path_name()=='/Game/SSPR_Validation/NS_SSPR_ProjTest.NS_SSPR_ProjTest':
            comp=candidate
            break
    if comp: break
if comp is None: raise RuntimeError('Level Niagara component not found')
rt=unreal.load_asset('/Game/SSPR_Validation/RT_SSPR_Occupancy')
if rt is None: raise RuntimeError('Occupancy RT not found')
comp.set_variable_texture_render_target('User.OccupancyRTParam',rt)
comp.set_force_solo(True)
comp.set_age_update_mode(unreal.NiagaraAgeUpdateMode.TICK_DELTA_TIME)
comp.reinitialize_system()
comp.activate(True)
comp.advance_simulation(120,1.0/60.0)
print('REACTIVATED='+repr({'component':comp.get_path_name(),'active':bool(comp.is_active()),'forceSolo':bool(comp.get_force_solo()),'rt':rt.get_path_name()}))
del candidate
del comp
del actor
del actors
